Start with active source observation E15 as a hydraulics-oriented probe, not because its catalogue label establishes diagnostic value. The six unpurchased active options cost at most 48 of 50, counting each once across contingencies. Avoid inactive options and repurchasing routing; defer unassigned observations while mapped options remain. Require disclosed pump/flow support before favoring circulation loss, and do not count shared-provenance observations as independent confirmation.
